what: A Vietnamese personalised-gift shop that sells in chat; the author runs its Meta ads. October 2026, three ad groups. Figures reported by the author from the shop's order book and the ad account, reconciled on 3 Nov 2026 (late payments and refunds included). The ad account's exports are no longer accessible to the author, so only these totals are published. Its payments did not go through Paid Signal or PayPal: it shows the gap Paid Signal closes, not a result of using it. 'Net' is revenue after refunds, before product, delivery and payment costs.
source: reported by the author (performance marketer running the shop's Meta ads), with the shop's agreement, anonymised; original ad-account exports not available

duplicate_payments.note: refunded in full; never counted as orders or revenue
